extraction.notes: Pass 1 full extraction from the converted text file under extraction rules 0.4. Multi-country Communication: only passages about North Macedonia and horizontal passages addressed to all Western Balkan or enlargement partners within Chapter 2 (as bounded in the run record) or the technology and AI theme were extracted. Method: keyword search over the whole file (country name, digital, cyber, AI, e-government, broadband, roaming, workers, social security, EURES, interoperability, electronic, data protection, connectivity, technology) and full reading of every page with a hit, including the whole North Macedonia summary in Annex 1 (pages 42-46) and the conclusions (pages 26-33). Annex 2 statistical tables (pages 65-73) have no in-scope indicators. Period covered left empty: the register gives none. Cybercrime passages (page 11) left out under R21. Chapter 2 appears only in the Annex 1 Cluster 2 summary (page 45). Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
